title: Nice!!
text: Nice!!. I bought a new fridge and it seems smaller than my old one. I needed to find a way to get more space so I got these. So happy I did because after I filled these up and put them in, I had much more space and the stuff inside is so much easier to get to..no more digging to the back of the shelf,..just pull the container out

product_metadata.title: Gomimeor Refrigerator Organizer Bins, 8pcs Clear Storage Bins, Fridge Organizer for Freezer, Kitchen, Cabinet, Pantry Organization and Storage, BPA Free
features: 【Large Pack Set of 8】The set of 8 refrigerator organizer bins comes in two different sizes, 4 Large bins, and 4 Medium ones. The large refrigerator bins are nesting and the medium ones are stackable. These clear fridge organizer bins have straight sides which use space efficiently. This set of 8 fridge storage bins has plenty of room to hold lots of things.

【Organizing Made Easy】The fridge organizer works great for organizing refrigerator or pantry shelves. Make it easy and practical to tidy up the fridge or pantry. Keep the refrigerator clean and neat. Great for veggies, fruits, milk, cans of soda, sauces, jams, condiments, snacks, etc.

【Sturdy and Clear】The fridge storage bins are made of durable shatter-resistant plastic which is food safe, BPA free, and very sturdy. The fridge storage containers are crystal clear. You can easily see what's inside the bin without digging through it.

【Functional and Versatile】With built-in handles, you can easily pull the clear fridge storage bins in and out of shelves. These fridge bins are great for your refrigerator organization and storage, freezer, cabinets, closets, kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms, etc. You can use them all over the house.

【Cleaning Method and Size】Easy to clean! Wash by hand with mild soapy water. These clear refrigerator organizer bins are NOT dishwasher safe. DO NOT place them in the dishwasher.The large fridge organizer bins measure 11.2” L x 7.5” W x 6.0” H.Medium bins 10.0” L x 6.0” W x 3.0” H.
